label: Delimiter / copy-phase echo of o, r, 2, m in long sequences
explanation: Fires essentially only at or after the <DEL> (99.7% of activations are in the delimiter or copy phase; almost never during the original input). Strongly modulated by sequence length: rate rises from ~0 at L<=5 to 12% of steps at L=9, and 88% of mass is in L>=8. The strongest activations are at the <DEL> step itself (26% of mass), often spreading to the first one or two copy steps. During the copy phase it prefers fed-back inputs o, r, 2 and m (o: 26% firing rate, r: 20%), and repeated tokens (in_first=0). It rarely fires at recall_idx 1-2 and rises again toward the end of long sequences (t=16-17). Copy-phase firing is diffuse and sporadic across many other tokens, so the predicate (delimiter or o/r/2/m in copy phase, L>=8) captures about 63% of mass at F1 ~0.48 on dev; it does not fire on original-phase tokens or short sequences.
